answer: To improve your memory of people's names, try practicing active listening when you first meet someone. Repeating the name back to them helps reinforce it. Connect the name with a visual image or a story related to the person, and use mnemonic devices like the first letters of the name forming a word or abbreviation. Frequent repetition and placing reminders can also help solidify the name in your memory.
